items.question: Når ser jeg ROI?
items.answer: Auditten genererer ikke direkte inntekter — det er diagnostikk og plan. ROI ser du etter implementering av anbefalingene. Typisk klient sparer 30-50% av annonsebudsjettet første måned.

items.question: For hvem er IKKE denne auditten?
items.answer: Hvis du har testede kanaler, god ROI, velfungerende markedsføring — trenger du ikke audit. Audit er fornuftig når noe ikke stemmer: budsjettet øker men resultatene står stille, du vet ikke hva du skal bruke penger på, konkurrenter passerer deg online.

items.question: Hva kommer konkret i rapporten?
items.answer: 1) Diagnose av nåværende tilstand. 2) Konkurranseanalyse. 3) ICP. 4) Kanalstrategi (hvilke kanaler, i hvilken rekkefølge, med hvilket budsjett). 5) ROI-rammeverk. 6) Handlingsplan med implementering (tidslinje, budsjetter, suksessmålinger).

items.question: Hvilke teknologier bruker dere?
items.answer: Next.js + React (frontend), Node.js / Python (backend), PostgreSQL / MongoDB (database), AWS / Vercel (hosting). For enkle verktøy: bare frontend (statisk HTML/JS). Vi velger teknologi for prosjektet.

faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about the consultation process

items.question: Does the form commit me to anything?
items.answer: No, filling out the form is just the first step — zero commitments, zero upfront payments. After submission we'll schedule a consultation call, show how configurator can work in your business, and present a quote. Only then you decide if we move forward.

items.question: What happens after I fill out the form?
items.answer: We'll contact you within 24h (business days). We'll schedule a consultation call (15–30 min) where we learn about your product, customization options, and business goals for the configurator. Then you receive quote + implementation plan.

items.question: What's the consultation call like?
items.answer: It's a workshop conversation, not a sales call. We ask about your product: What are customization options? Who buys? How many combinations need to be shown? Where do customers order (store, distributors)? Do you need system integration? Based on this we price and plan the configurator.

items.question: How long does the whole process take?
items.answer: From form to quote: 2–3 days. From quote acceptance to finished configurator: 4–12 weeks (depends on complexity). Simple configurators (color + text) take 4 weeks. Advanced with 3D and integrations — 8–12 weeks. Exact timeline you get on consultation.

items.question: Do I need to have ready photos/descriptions of the product?
items.answer: No, for consultation it's enough to tell about the product and customization options. Photos, descriptions, specifications we'll collect later, before project start. If you have them — great, we'll use them. If not — we'll advise what to prepare.

items.question: What do I get after the consultation call?
items.answer: Detailed quote (what configurator costs for your product), implementation timeline (how many weeks building takes), feature list (what exactly you get), examples (similar configurators we built). Everything in writing, no surprises.

items.question: What if I change my mind after consultation?
items.answer: That's okay! Consultation is free and without commitments. If quote doesn't fit budget, or configurator isn't what you need — you just say thanks and we end there. No pressure, no weird questions.
